page.layout: Two columns of index entries, left and right. Left column: entries from "Machiavellus" to "Mosis", with page references. Right column: letter N, entries from "Nazarenus" to "Papa", with a letter O and a letter P heading groups of entries. No margin notes, no catchword, no signature.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Several small numerals in the references (for example the "s" forms after 1.5. and the reading after "Ophitae") are doubtful, because the scan is faint and the old figure form is unclear; they are marked [?] where they were read. "Item" and "Epist." are set in italic in the print. The page is a two-column index with no marginal notes.
